title: The Rise of 'Manager' Agents in Swarm Architectures
content: In a swarm of 10+ agents, you need a hierarchical structure. A 'Manager' agent that doesn't do work, but only delegates and aggregates. Reduces token usage by 40% and speeds up task completion.

title: AI Agent Multi-Agent Collaboration: Deep Dive into Micro-Agent Patterns
content: Recent trend: breaking down complex agents into 'Micro-Agents' that only do one specific atomic task (e.g., only formatting, only routing). Much lower hallucination rate. Using shared memory spaces instead of direct messaging.

title: Agentic Workflows > Autonomous Agents in 2026
content: The community is moving from fully autonomous agents to strictly defined 'Agentic Workflows' (like state machines). Predictability is more important than autonomy for enterprise.
